description.fallback: After finishing the pillar trial, Joseph confronts Lisa Lisa about the ill treatment he received, planning to exact revenge. Lisa Lisa casually passes Joseph a glass of water, and after catching it without making it spill, Joseph realizes that the training had satisfying results. Acknowledging her teaching method, Joseph gets down on his knees and begs Lisa Lisa to start the next part of the training.
